theme: Indus object identity, context, source and rights ledger
question: Can a 200-carrier local pilot connect corpus faces, source-qualified aliases, museum records and archaeological context while preserving missingness and conflicting assertions?
outcome: 200 carrier records at 34 sites across eight export regions; 180 corpus-linked and 20 catalogue-only. 256 Lipi faces and three Mayig transcriptions. 26 confirmed museum joins; 34 candidate search-bucket links across nine records and ten objects. Matched gains: 26 accessions, 22 excavation unit/item pairs, 62 attributed calendar intervals and two dimension-bearing objects; zero dating-sample links. 158 checks pass and ten selection/result files replay byte-for-byte. Annotations remain Exploratory.
challenge: Source and face identities remain partly unreviewed; external aliases are often absent; museum fields conflict; imagery and transcription assets have different rights; period intervals lack object sample associations.
remedy: Freeze deterministic selection; store source assertions and candidate links separately; validate schema/references/units/intervals; keep glyph payloads local; preserve the failed provenance endpoint; provide 134 specific review questions and a concordance-gated 1979 import interface.
retry_when: Reviewed object/surface concordances, Package M digitization and exact 1979 crosswalks, new primary registrations, dated-sample associations or licensed image assets become available. Add a new layer/endpoint; preserve this pilot.
